description: Hardcore survival overhaul mod for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.8 featuring energy-based movement, dynamic mining instability, environmental collapse events, and crafting quality tiers

mods.name: Eroded World
mods.description: Eroded World is a survival overhaul mod focused on darkness, stamina management, environmental danger and slower, more strategic gameplay. Mining, combat and movement are influenced by energy and world conditions, creating a harsher and more immersive Minecraft experience.

releases.notes:
## Eroded World – Minecraft 26.3-pre.2

This is an **experimental test build** of Eroded World for **Minecraft 26.3-pre.2**.

The mod has been updated to support the API changes introduced in this pre-release, including fixes required for entity handling, death holograms, Enderman-related mixins and other compatibility changes.

### Important

Minecraft **26.3-pre.2 is still a pre-release version**. Internal APIs and game behavior may continue to change before the final Minecraft 26.3 release.

Because of this, this build may still contain unexpected bugs, crashes or compatibility issues.

### Notes

- Designed for **Minecraft 26.3-pre.2**
- Fabric
- Cloth Config API is no longer required
- Uses Eroded World's own configuration system
- Includes compatibility fixes for 26.3-pre.2
- Existing Eroded World gameplay systems remain available

⚠️ **This version is intended for testing.**

Back up important worlds before using it and please report any problems together with `latest.log` or a crash report.

releases.notes:
# Eroded World – Major Update

This update focuses on gameplay improvements, bug fixes, and overall mod stability.

## Dependency Change

**Cloth Config API is no longer required.**

Eroded World now only requires:

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Java 25

## Main Changes

* Reworked **Mining and Energy** behavior.
* Improved **Cave Collapse and Stabilizer** mechanics.
* **Light Eaters** can now destroy regular and Soul torches, lanterns, and campfires.
* Fixed and improved **Energy HUD positioning**.
* Improved **Territory, Claims, Loot, and Death Chest** systems.
* Improved **client/server synchronization and data persistence**.
* Various smaller gameplay and stability fixes.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MSWHendys/Eroded_World/compare/v1.0.0-beta.2...v1.1.0_26.2
